label: Студент
description: Twelve-mission case drill for студент (student) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form студент carries a zero ending and names the subject of the sentence. Here студент is the one doing the speaking, so it stays in the nominative as the grammatical subject.

Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The nominative студент adds -а to become студента. The construction нет plus possession with у both demand the genitive, so the absent owner of the textbook appears as студента.
Strategic focus: Dative singular. The ending shifts to -у, giving студенту. The verb помогать governs the dative, marking студенту as the recipient of the help.

Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The direct object of знать takes the accusative, but because студент is animate, the accusative copies the genitive: студента, not студент. Animacy is the reason the object ends in -а.

Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The ending becomes -ом, producing студентом. The preposition с meaning together with requires the instrumental, marking студентом as the companion in the conversation.
Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. The ending is -е, giving студенте. The preposition о meaning about forces the prepositional, the case used for the topic of speech.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural subject takes -ы, giving студенты. As the doers of the writing, they stand in the nominative.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The genitive plural ending -ов yields студентов. The word нет signalling absence governs the genitive, so the missing people appear as студентов.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. The plural dative ending -ам gives студентам. The verb рассказать marks the listeners as recipients, so they take the dative студентам.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. The direct object of уважать would be accusative, but animacy makes the accusative plural copy the genitive plural: студентов. The -ов ending reflects this animate rule, not the bare nominative студенты.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The instrumental plural ending -ами produces студентами. The preposition с meaning with requires the instrumental, naming студентами as the people met.

missions.phrase: В фильме речь идёт о студентах.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. The prepositional plural ending -ах gives студентах. The preposition о meaning about governs the prepositional, marking студентах as the subject of the film.
